description: Create and manage events on Google Calendar.

google_calendar_cancelled_event_trigger.description: Runs when an event in Google Calendar is cancelled or deleted, including one occurrence of a repeating event.

output.attendees: Everyone invited, as a list of email addresses (text, such as sam@example.com), one per guest: the calendar's own address and any rooms included. For the people only, use guest_emails.
output.created: When the event was made, in UTC.
output.description: The event's notes. Blank when it has none.
output.end: When it ends, written the same way as start.
output.end_display: Beta. When it ends, ready to read, in the calendar's time zone, written the same way as start_display. Blank when Google gave no end.
output.guest_emails: Beta. The guests' email addresses, as a list of text, leaving out the calendar's own address and rooms and other resources. Empty when nobody else was invited.
output.has_outside_guests: Beta. true when at least one guest is from outside your organisation (outside_guest_emails is not empty), for a step that should only run for external meetings.
output.html_link: The address of the event's page in Google Calendar.
output.id: The event's ID, for the event steps' Event field.
output.location: Where it takes place. Blank when no place is set.
output.outside_guest_emails: Beta. The guests from outside your organisation: those whose email domain (the part after @) differs from the calendar owner's, as a list of text. When the calendar belongs to an address at a personal domain such as gmail.com, every guest counts as outside. Pass it straight to a step that takes several addresses.
output.owner_email: Beta. The email address of the person whose calendar it is, for a task or message to them ('a follow-up for me'). Blank when Google doesn't say.
output.start: When it starts, as the calendar gives it: a date and time with the calendar's UTC offset, such as 2026-11-03T09:30:00-05:00, or just a date (2026-11-03) for an all-day event.
output.start_display: Beta. When it starts, ready to read, in the calendar's time zone: Tue, Nov 3, 2026, 9:30 AM, or Tue, Nov 3, 2026 (all day).
output.updated: When the event was last changed, in UTC.

parameters.description: The Google Calendar ID to watch. Leave blank to use your primary calendar.
parameters.name: calendar_id
